name: Avala Run
description: Penjaš se Avalom pre zore kao DJ koji kasni. Skupljaj smeće i karte, izbegavaj prepreke, gledaj daily highscore — pobednici dobijaju kartu za pravu Avalu, 20. juna.

modules.src/main.js: Entry point, game loop, state machine orchestrator
modules.src/config.js: Sve konstante — brzine, hitboxovi, boje, aforizmi, save key
modules.src/state.js: GameState shape, createState(), daily highscore localStorage
modules.src/audio.js: Web Audio API — bass beat, card ding, trash klank, game over
modules.src/render.js: Glavni canvas renderer — background, player, obstacles, collectibles, HUD canvas elems
modules.src/ui.js: DOM HUD update, menu overlay, game over screen sa aforizmi i linkovima
modules.src/entities/player.js: Player state, physics (jump/duck/run), pixel art draw funkcija
modules.src/systems/world.js: Parallax background slojevi, ground, scrollOffset tracking
modules.src/systems/spawner.js: Obstacle i collectible spawning logika, gap management
modules.src/systems/collision.js: AABB collision detection za player vs obstacles/collectibles
modules.styles/ui.css: HUD, overlay, menu, game over screen stilovi
